headline: 1933: Americans pan for gold at *$33 an ounce*
quote: With gold now at $33 an ounce
title: Gold was $33 an ounce in 1933 (real newsreel)
caption: November 1933: the US government was raising the price it paid for gold, and amateur prospectors rushed to dig. In 1934 it fixed the price at $35.
comment: Would you rather own gold or stocks? 👇
